title: 8-line-to-3-line priority encoder (equal to 9318)

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54147, SN54148, SN54LS147, SN54LS148, SN74147, SN74148 (TIM9907), SN74LS147, SN74LS148, bulletin DL-S 7611727 (October 1976)

pins.text: data input, active low, lowest priority
data input, active low, highest priority

functions.formula: A2 = NOT(EI' AND (4' OR 5' OR 6' OR 7'))
functions.text: Low when enabled and any of inputs 4-7 is low.

functions.formula: A1 = NOT(EI' AND (7' OR 6' OR (5 AND 4 AND 3') OR (5 AND 4 AND 2')))
functions.text: Inverted bit 1 of the number of the highest-numbered low input.

functions.formula: A0 = NOT(EI' AND (7' OR (6 AND 5') OR (6 AND 4 AND 3') OR (6 AND 4 AND 2 AND 1')))
functions.text: Inverted bit 0 of the number of the highest-numbered low input.

functions.formula: GS = NOT(EI' AND (0' OR 1' OR 2' OR 3' OR 4' OR 5' OR 6' OR 7'))
functions.text: Low when enabled and at least one data input is low.

functions.formula: EO = NOT(EI' AND 0 AND 1 AND 2 AND 3 AND 4 AND 5 AND 6 AND 7)
functions.text: Low when enabled and no data input is low; feeds EI of the next lower-priority stage.

electrical.notes: Input 0 is a double load: IIL -3.2 mA max, IIH 80 uA (Req 2 kOhm); other inputs IIL -1.6 mA, IIH 40 uA.
